notes.title: Cave Crawler Patch #2 04/23/23
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

Improved level loading to not stutter when changing levels.
Made quitting from pause fade out.
Export game as a Release build. (May help with performance and issues)


Still looking into the freezing and crashing some people are having, but it is hard as there is no clear reason. Will make a post later to give a list of things you can do to try and fix it.

notes.title: Cave Crawler Patch 04/23/23
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

Added small intro.
Fixed issue with options menu being off center.


Known Issues:

Currently looking into an issue where the game freeze/crashes. If you are having this issue trying running the game with OpenGL. It is not recommended but it might be a workaround.
